{{SameName|Cold Mist|[[Cold Mist (Frost Invasion)|Frost Invasion]] • [[Cold Mist (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus Frosthold]] • [[Cold Mist|Modern]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date = 4th of December 2021|event = [[Frost Invasion Event]]}} {{Zombie |image-static = ColdMist.png |image-dynamic = ColdMistLegacyDynamic.png |title1 = Cold Mist |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |first_wave_appearance = 5 (Originally) |tab_1 = Event |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]30 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |spawned_by = [[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |fly = No |ghost = {{Attr|Ghost|Yes}} |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cold Mist''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Compared to the [[Snowy (Frost Invasion)|Snowy]], the '''Cold Mist''' had slightly higher health with slower speed. However, the '''Cold Mist's''' was a hidden and ghost enemy, meaning that only certain towers could target and damage it, making it a potential danger early on. Upon its death, the [[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] had a chance to spawn the '''Cold Mist'''. ==Appearance== The '''Cold Mist's''' entire body is black and translucent. It is faceless and blue smoke particles were emitted from its torso. The '''Cold Mist''' floats a small distance above the path. Its head is slightly tilted downwards. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *The [[Military Base]] is useless against the '''Cold Mist''', as its [[units]] will go right through them, as the '''Cold Mist''' is a ghost enemy. **For the same reason, the [[Crook Boss]]' [[units]] cannot collide with nor detect the '''Cold Mist''', also making them useless. *Level 2 [[Minigunner]]s are your best bet against the '''Cold Mist''', as they perform very well against it. **You can also use the [[Accelerator]] since it has hidden detection from Level 0. **The [[Crook Boss]] also fares decently well against the '''Cold Mist''', though its range is not optimal. *It is generally advised that multiple players save for the [[Minigunner]] starting from the beginning of the game, to ensure sufficient DPS against the '''Cold Mist''' once it debuts. *The [[Pyromancer]] is close to useless against the '''Cold Mist''', as it cannot target them. **However, its flames can still damage the '''Cold Mist''', so long there is another detectable enemy in range. *Later on during the match, you can use a Level 4 [[Ace Pilot]] to grant hidden detection to other towers that cannot detect '''Cold Mists''', like the [[Ranger]]. **However, the [[Ace Pilot]] will only grant hidden detection for 15 seconds at the start of the match, making this fairly unreliable. *While most splash damage towers do not have hidden detection, such as the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]], if another detectable enemy is nearby, the '''Cold Mist''' may be indirectly damaged if caught in the explosion. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyColdMist.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionColdMistIconIG.png|'''Cold Mist''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Cold Mist''' was very similar to the [[Ghost (Trick or Threat Town)|Ghost]] in the [[Halloween 2020 Event]] in terms of functionality and animation. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Cold Mist''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Cold Mist''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Cold Mist''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Cold Mist]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox
